question_defect: The question names the quantity as 'The linear expansion of metal', but 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ is the coefficient of linear expansion; the printed name is incomplete and its unit belongs to the coefficient, not to an expansion.
notes: Solved independently first: a hole in a sheet expands with the same coefficient as the solid metal, so d′ = d(1 + αΔT) = 5(1 + 2×10⁻⁵ × 200) = 5 × 1.004 = 5.020 cm exactly, which is option 2. Python confirms the 2α route gives 5.040 cm, so common_mistakes[1] points at the right option. common_mistakes[0] (expecting the hole to shrink) is the genuine misconception on this question and is correctly answered. ΔT is the same number in K and °C, so writing 200 K after subtracting Celsius values is not an error.
